contents: Official NASA video of Perseverance's entry, descent and landing (Feb 18, 2021): parachute deploy, heat-shield separation, descent-stage view of Jezero crater, sky-crane touchdown, with mission-control audio. Re-encoded from the 1080p master (10 Mbps) to ~2 Mbps to stay under 60 MB.
